 Paramore's Hayley Williams brings solo show to Manila
 Jan Milo Severo - Philstar.com November 17, 2026 | 11:59am 
 Hayley Williams performing her eponymous show in Seattle, Washington last September 30, 2026. Ryan Russell via Instagram 
 MANILA, Philippines — Paramore frontwoman Hayley Williams is bringing her solo show to the Philippines, with a concert scheduled on February 24, 2027, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.
 Concert promoter Ovation Productions announced the Manila stop of “The Hayley Williams Show” through a social media post.
 The show will give Filipino fans an opportunity to see the Grammy-winning singer perform outside her work with American rock band Paramore.
 The artist presale will run from November 18 at 12 p.m. until November 19 at 11:59 p.m. Philippine time.
 General ticket sales will begin on November 20 at 12 p.m.
 Tickets will be available through Ticketnet's official website, ticketnet.com.ph, and its physical outlets.
 Williams is best known as the lead vocalist of Paramore, which rose to international prominence through songs such as “Misery Business”, “The Only Exception”, “Still Into You” and “Ain't It Fun”.
 Aside from her work with the band, Williams has also pursued a solo career, releasing the albums “Petals for Armor” in 2020 and “Flowers for Vases / Descansos” in 2021.
 Her Manila concert marks another opportunity for Filipino fans to see the singer perform live in the country.
